# game-intel AI site (game catalog + guides + live intel)

Machine-readable endpoints. Timezone: Asia/Shanghai.
Base URL (hosted): https://game-intel-ai.dyk1454683243.workers.dev
Game entities dual-published from `data/games/` → `/v1/games/{id}.json` and `/games/{id}.html`.
Guide cards dual-published from `data/guides/`.
`v1/digest|radar|calendar-hw` from best-effort MCP/CLI export.
OpenAPI 3.1: /v1/openapi.json (same document as /openapi.json). Developer page (中文 + English): /developers/ — endpoints, curl, MCP clients, sources, and attribution.
Remote MCP: GET /.well-known/mcp.json (same AI Catalog as /.well-known/ai-catalog.json). Connect at /mcp. Tools read published JSON. They do not scrape HTML. list_banners, list_codes, and personal_digest cover the eight deep games.

## Depth / 目录宽、深耕窄

- Light catalog (`stub: true`, `watchlist: false`): identity only — `id`, `name`, `name_zh`, `platforms`, `tags`, `sources[{label,url}]`, `steam_appid`, `note`, `as_of`, `timezone`. No character cards.
- Watchlist deep dive: full character cards, banners, and codes for eight games — hw, nikke, bd2, reverse-1999, arknights-endfield, limbus-company, zenless-zone-zero, wuthering-waves. star, asora, miraesi, lo2 stay thin until a card has https sources.
- Do not invent Metacritic, prices, player counts, skill numbers, or gacha rates. Human HTML and JSON are the same facts.

## Sources / 出处

Priority when two links disagree: official (Steam news, publisher, store page) > review sites (Prydwen, Inven, GameKee 测评, Bahamut, TapTap) > forums (Reddit, Discord).
Channel registry: `data/sources.json` (`enabled`, `type`, `note`, optional `zone` / `role`). Live digest/radar fetchers are the enabled api/html/rss rows (GameKee, TapTap, Inven, Steam news+store, Bahamut, Prydwen, nikke.gg, watchlist official). Language-zone outlets without a fetcher stay `enabled: false`: Bilibili, 小黑盒, 루리웹, 아카라이브, 4Gamer, Famitsu, 電ファミ, Reddit, Discord, App Store, Google Play, Steam coming-soon. Do not treat a registry row as a live headline.
If the JSON does not support a claim, say 未见可靠出处 / no reliable source. Do not fill the gap.
On a thin item, quote 1–2 sentences already stored and cite `url`.

## How to answer

1. Resolve the game id. Catalog nicknames: look up the alias in /v1/catalog-aliases.json, read `id`, then GET /v1/games/{id}.json. Or use any id in /v1/games/index.json (hw, nikke, bd2, …). Character nicknames are /v1/guides/{game}/aliases.json, not the catalog file.
2. Build questions use /v1/guides/{game}/characters/{id}.json. Read `summary` (结论), `skills`, `sources`, `as_of`.
3. `stub: true` means the card or the catalog row is incomplete. `summary.stub: true` means the conclusion is incomplete. Do not collapse those two flags.
4. Live headlines are only /v1/digest.json, /v1/feed.json, /v1/radar.json, /v1/calendar.json. Empty arrays or `meta.fixture: true` mean no item.
5. Sourced claims: POST /v1/claims with no API key. Required: statement text, https source URLs, and game_id. Read GET /v1/claims.json and /claims/index.html. There is no review queue; listed rows are untrusted until a human checks them. No key on GET.
6. Redeem codes stay on game-welfare. This site does not serve CDK, Discourse, ads, or billing.

## Public access / 对外访问

- `GET /v1/health` returns `{ok:true, api_version:"1", rate_limit}`. `rate_limit` is `degraded` when the Worker rate-limit bindings are missing; the request is still allowed.
- Worker responses send `X-API-Version: 1`. Published JSON bodies stay as exported. Health and gate errors include `api_version`.
- Anonymous calls are allowed. Optional key: `X-API-Key` or `Authorization: Bearer`. The Worker secret `GAME_INTEL_API_KEYS` is a comma-separated list and is not in this repo. An unrecognized key is HTTP 401 `{ok:false,error:"invalid_api_key",message,api_version,status}`. Omitting the key uses the anonymous tier.
- Public limiter, only when the bindings exist: anonymous 120 requests per 60 seconds per IP, keyed 1200 per 60 seconds per key. Counters are per Cloudflare location. HTTP 429 sends `Retry-After: 60` and `{ok:false,error:"rate_limited",api_version,status,tier,limit,retry_after}`.
- `POST /v1/claims` does not use this key and does not use this limiter. Its KV limits are unchanged (10 per IP per Asia/Shanghai hour, 100 per day). `CLAIMS_API_KEY` is not required and is not read. Claims 429 body stays `{ok:false,error:"rate_limited",scope,limit}`.
- Static `/v1/*.json` is cacheable (`Cache-Control: public, max-age=300`) and sends `ETag`. `If-None-Match` returns 304.
- Gate errors: `{ok:false, error, message, api_version, status}`. MCP protocol errors stay JSON-RPC. HTTP 429 on `/mcp` uses the gate body.
- Human page: /developers/.

## Routes

Catalog and guides update on publish (`npm run export-games` / `export-guides` in `ai-site/`). Digest, radar, calendar, and watchlist are best-effort daily via `export-intel`. Feed is rebuilt from real digest + radar rows during `export-games`.

### GET /v1/games/index.json
Purpose: wide directory (轻目录). Cadence: on publish.
Fields: `as_of`, `timezone`, `count`, `watchlist_count`, `stub_count`, `games[]` `{id,name,name_zh,platforms,tags,stub,watchlist,steam_appid,path}`.
Shape sample (repo, not the live index): `examples/games-index.slice.example.json`.

### GET /v1/games/{id}.json
Purpose: one entity. Catalog stubs have no guide body. Cadence: on publish.
Fields: `id`, `name`, `name_zh`, `platforms`, `tags`, `sources[]`, `steam_appid`, `stub`, `watchlist`, `guides_path`, `note`, `as_of`, `timezone`.
Shape sample (repo): `examples/game-stub.example.json`. Live stub:

{"id":"balatro","name":"Balatro","name_zh":"小丑牌","platforms":["steam","pc","switch"],"tags":["indie","roguelike","card"],"sources":[{"label":"Steam","url":"https://store.steampowered.com/app/2379780/"}],"steam_appid":2379780,"stub":true,"watchlist":false,"as_of":"2026-09-25","timezone":"Asia/Shanghai"}

### GET /v1/catalog-aliases.json
Purpose: wide-catalog nicknames (CN / EN / KR) → game id. Cadence: on publish (`export-games` merges `data/catalog-aliases.json` with each game's `name` and `name_zh`).
Resolve: alias key → `id` → GET /v1/games/{id}.json.
Fields: `as_of`, `timezone`, `count`, `aliases{key → {id,name,lang}}`. `lang` is `zh`, `en`, `ko`, `ja`, or `other`.
Character nicknames stay on /v1/guides/{game}/aliases.json. This file is not a second catalog and has no scores.

### GET /v1/feed.json
Purpose: cross-game headlines already present in digest or radar. Cadence: each catalog export.
Fields: `meta.{as_of,timezone,generated_at,source,count,note}`, `items[]` `{title,url,game_id,platform,published_at,source}`.
Empty `items` is valid.

### GET /v1/watchlist.json
Purpose: narrow daily watch list. Cadence: best-effort daily.
Fields: `meta.{fixture,generated_at,timezone,source}`, `games[]` `{id,name,name_zh,keywords,gamekee_alias,steam_appid,official_url}`.
`meta.fixture: true` is sample data, not live intel.

### GET /v1/digest.json
Purpose: per watched game, recent headlines. Cadence: best-effort daily.
Fields: `meta.{generated_at,timezone,source}`, `digests[]` `{game,name,count,items[]{title,url,source,summary?}}`.
`summary` is a clipped blurb already stored. Do not extend it.

### GET /v1/radar.json
Purpose: new-game / CBT / 预约 scan by language and platform. Not a second catalog. Cadence: best-effort daily.
Live CLI sweeps are TapTap, Inven, and GameKee. Keywords in code: 公测, 预约, CBT, 新作, launch. Other language-zone outlets are registry rows in `data/sources.json` (`enabled: false`) until a fetcher exists.
Fields: `meta`, `keywords`, `items[]` `{title,url,source,why}`.

### GET /v1/calendar.json and /v1/calendar-hw.json
Purpose: dated events. Cadence: best-effort daily (HW file from the HW calendar export).
Fields: `as_of`, `count`, `events[]` `{game,type,title,start,end,url,source,confidence}`. `confidence` is `low` or `high`. `type` is banner, event, maintenance, collab, login, or other.

### GET /v1/guides/index.json and /v1/guides/{game}/…
Purpose: watchlist character guides. Catalog stubs have no cards here. Cadence: on `export-guides`.
Card fields: `id`, `name`, `game`, `stub`, `sources`, `as_of`, `skills`, `skill_prio`, `teams`, `summary.{stub,tier?,pull?,sources}`.
`skill_prio` is cited 加点 or 练度 lines. `teams` is short cited 配队 text: HW `dopamine_auto` is A/B/C, HW mode keys use the source √/×, `comp` is verbatim sentences, and a BD2 key may be a costume name. Empty means the source did not state it.
Non-stub cards require https `sources` and `as_of`. HW `summary.tier` is the GameKee 图鉴 T度 already stored. `summary.pull` only when the card already quoted 抽取建议. NIKKE and BD2 position is class, burst, element, rarity, or role — not a tier list or a price.
Aliases: /v1/guides/{game}/aliases.json (nikke also aliases.p1.json … p4.json).
HW dopamine auto: /v1/guides/hw/dopamine-auto.json (also /v1/guides/hw/modes/dopamine-auto.json).
Banners: /v1/guides/{game}/banners.json. Codes: /v1/guides/{game}/codes.json. Both keep the source URL, the checked date, and an explicit expired or unstated status. Do not treat a code as live when status is expired or expiry_not_stated.

### GET /v1/planner
Purpose: derived current and future banner timeline. No stored plan. Reads published `/v1/guides/{game}/banners.json`, `/v1/calendar.json`, and `/v1/guides/{game}/codes.json`.
Dates are the `YYYY-MM-DD` prefix already on a row. Prose dates are not parsed. Ended banners are omitted.
`pull_math` is `cited_summons` only when a banner `note` states 「首个 N 次征集内必得」. That sentence is the only shortfall. Qualitative 保底 lines are quoted and do not become a number. Other games are `timeline_only`. Redeem-code rewards are listed and are not converted into pulls.
Optional query: `game` (one slug) and `resources` (`game:count`, comma-separated). `resources` is not stored. Human page `/planner/` keeps the checklist and resource counts in `localStorage` and does not send them.
Response sends `ETag`, `Cache-Control: public, max-age=300`, and `X-API-Version`. `stored` is false.

### GET /v1/compare?ids=
Purpose: derived side-by-side fields for 2 to 4 character cards in one game. `ids` is comma-separated `game:id`. Nothing is stored.
Rows are attributes already on the card (role, element, rarity, and the other stored class fields), rating text with its https sources, team lines, and skill name plus summary. An empty cell is JSON `null`. The human page prints 暂无出处 and does not fill the cell. Human page: `/compare/?ids=game:id,game:id`, plus `/en/compare/` and `/ja/compare/`.
Response sends `ETag`, `Cache-Control: public, max-age=300`, and `X-API-Version`. `stored` is false. `gap` is the string 暂无出处.

### GET /v1/personal and GET /v1/personal.atom
Purpose: stateless personal digest. No account and no stored follows. The browser page `/me/` keeps the list in `localStorage` and filters the same published JSON locally. Bots call this endpoint or the MCP tool `personal_digest`.
Query: `games` (comma-separated ids, max 24) and `chars` (comma-separated `game:id`, max 48). `code` is a `gi1.` share code and replaces the other two parameters when present.
Cadence: computed on request from published `/v1/feed.json`, `/v1/digest.json`, and each relevant `/v1/guides/{game}/banners.json`, `codes.json`, character index, and aliases. Nothing is written.
Filter: a followed game keeps its feed and digest items. A followed character keeps items from that game whose title or summary contains a published name or alias. Banners stay for followed games, plus any banner whose `up_characters.id` matches a followed character. Codes stay for followed games and for the games of followed characters.
Highlights: `up` when that character is in `up_characters`. `rerun` when `kind` is `rerun`, or the banner name places that character after 复刻 / 復刻 / rerun. A code is `new` when it is not expired and `starts` or `released` is an ISO date within the previous 45 Asia/Shanghai days. A code is `expiring` when it is not expired and `expires` is an ISO date within the next 21 Asia/Shanghai days, including today. Non-ISO dates are not treated as new or expiring. Expired rows stay marked. This does not redeem codes.
`stored` is false. Atom is `/v1/personal.atom` with the same query. Human page: `/me/?games=&chars=` imports into that browser only.
Schema: `/schema/personal.schema.json`.

### GET /v1/claims.json and POST /v1/claims
GET fields: `ok`, `count`, `timezone`, `claims[]` `{id,statement,sources,game_id,character_id,as_of,submitted_at,timezone,submitter?}`. No auth. `list_claims` returns this same list and does not write.
There is no pending/approved queue. Public posts are stored and listed as submitted. They are untrusted until a human reviews them. Do not treat a claim as a verified fact.
POST is public. No API key and no Authorization header. `CLAIMS_API_KEY`, if already set on the Worker, is not checked and is not required.
POST body: `statement` (required, 1–2000 chars; `claim` is an alias), `sources` (required, 1–8 https URLs), `game_id` (required slug; `game` is an alias). Optional: `character_id`, `as_of`, `submitter` (≤80).
Sources must be https with a real host. Rejected: empty, `javascript:`, `data:`, `http:`, userinfo, IP literals, single-label hosts, localhost, and placeholder hosts (`example` / `placeholder` / `changeme` / `fake` labels, plus `.example`, `.invalid`, `.test`, `.localhost`, `.local`).
Caps (also in `ai-site/src/claims.js`): body ≤ 16384 bytes; statement ≤ 2000; each URL ≤ 500.
Rate limit uses Workers KV binding `CLAIMS`, Asia/Shanghai: 10 posts per IP per hour, 100 posts per calendar day globally. `429` body is `{ok:false,error:"rate_limited",scope:"ip"|"day",limit}`. Missing KV is `503` `claims_kv_unconfigured`. Oversized body is `413` `body_too_large`. Missing game id is `400` `game_id_required`. Bad source is `400` `invalid_source`.
Cadence: on submit. Humans: /claims/index.html.

### MCP
GET /.well-known/mcp.json then /mcp (read-only streamable HTTP). `read_llms` returns this file. `list_banners`, `list_codes`, and `personal_digest` cover the eight deep games. Other tools map to the GET routes above. Client setup is on /developers/.

## Human pages

Browser UI (Chinese, fetches live `/v1` JSON, no login, no CDK):

- / — digest summary + radar glance (`/v1/digest.json`, `/v1/radar.json`)
- /catalog/ — search and filter the game directory
- /watchlist/ — hw, nikke, bd2, reverse-1999, arknights-endfield, limbus-company, zenless-zone-zero, wuthering-waves, plus thin rows star (星原), asora (阿索拉), miraesi (미래시), lo2
- /game/?id= — identity card (name, platforms, tags, sources, steam_appid). Games outside the eight deep ids show 尚无深耕 and do not invent tier or pull advice.
- /character/?game=&id= — strength, costume, skills, and source links. Deep games: hw, nikke, bd2, reverse-1999, arknights-endfield, limbus-company, zenless-zone-zero, wuthering-waves. A 关注 button writes that character into localStorage. 加入对比 opens `/compare/?add=game:id`.
- /developers/ — Chinese and English notes for the public API and remote MCP.
- /me/ — personal view. Follow list is localStorage plus a shareable `/me/?games=&chars=` link or `gi1.` code. The page filters feed, digest, banners, and codes in the browser and does not send the list to the server. Followed characters can be added to `/planner/` in one step.
- /planner/ — pull planner. Also `/en/planner/` and `/ja/planner/`. Checklist and resource counts stay in localStorage. The timeline is `GET /v1/planner`.
- /compare/?ids= — 2 to 4 cards from one game. Also `/en/compare/` and `/ja/compare/`. Empty fields render as 暂无出处.

`export-games` copies `ai-site/public/ui/home.html` onto `/`. Static dual-publish HTML remains:

- /games/index.html — Chinese game directory
- /games/{id}.html — game detail
- /guides/index.html — guide index
- /guides/hw/index.html, /guides/nikke/index.html, /guides/bd2/index.html
- /guides/{game}/{id}.html — character page; 结论 mirrors `summary`
- /claims/index.html — claims mirror

`stub` and 未见可靠出处 stay visible when the JSON carries them.

## Schemas and contract

- /v1/openapi.json — OpenAPI 3.1 (same document as /openapi.json)
- /developers/ — curl, MCP client config, source rules, attribution
- /schema/game.schema.json — stub vs watchlist is documented on the schema
- /schema/games-index.schema.json
- /schema/feed.schema.json
- /schema/watchlist.schema.json
- /schema/digest.schema.json
- /schema/calendar.schema.json
- /schema/guides-index.schema.json
- /schema/character-card.schema.json
- /schema/aliases.schema.json — character nicknames
- /schema/catalog-aliases.schema.json — catalog nickname → id
- /schema/personal.schema.json — stateless personal digest
- /schema/claim.schema.json
- /schema/claims-index.schema.json
- /index.md — overview
- /llms.txt — this file
- Repo shape samples (not served): `examples/game-stub.example.json`, `examples/games-index.slice.example.json`

## Notes

- Content-Type: application/json for /v1/*, /schema/*, and /openapi.json
- Public GET routes work without a key. A valid `GAME_INTEL_API_KEYS` entry raises the /v1 and /mcp limit. POST /v1/claims stays keyless.
- Re-export: `npm run export-guides && npm run export-games` (export-guides refuses non-stub cards that lack sources, as_of, or — for hw/nikke/bd2 — a summary row)
- `ai-site/llms.txt` is the source of published /llms.txt. `export-games` copies it; do not hand-edit `ai-site/public/llms.txt`.
